name: Roam Research
description: Roam Research lets agents search, read, and add blocks and pages in the Roam graphs of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Roam account through the browser.

prompts.text: What did I write in my daily notes this week?
Find all blocks that link to [[Project Atlas]].
Add a block with today's meeting notes to my daily page.

apps.name: Roam Research
apps.description: Graph search, pages, and blocks, over Roam Research's MCP server with browser sign-in.
